title: Who Is a God Like You?
summary: God is not like us: slow to forgive and quick to anger. He delights in steadfast love and casts our sins into the depths of the sea. Come now.
exhortation: What a hope we have this morning, we who are weak, needy and sinful, if we will simply come to Jesus.

Let's not fall into the trap of thinking God is just like us. We can be slow to forgive, quick to anger and not very compassionate, especially when someone has wronged us. Our God is not like that. He is quick to show compassion, slow to anger and always ready to forgive.

It's a lie of the enemy that says we can't come to God right away and ask for forgiveness. The enemy says, "Wait a while. Grovel a bit. Be miserable about your sin first." That isn't what Jesus says. He says, "Come." No sinner who repents will be rejected. He will take all our sin and cast it into the depths of the sea.
The power to change is found in repenting, not in working harder or punishing ourselves. The punishment was poured out on Jesus so that we might be forgiven. And so we are.
prayer: Lord, we pray that we would run to you this morning with our mistakes, failures and sins, all of it. We are flawed people, separated from you by our sin if not for your work, Jesus. Now we are covered. Our sins are removed from us as far as the east is from the west, cast into the sea. May we come to you quickly and boldly.

I pray specifically for people who are trapped this morning in a sin they keep returning to, who don't believe this is true for them. Give them faith to see that sin broken in their lives, and help them run to you, Jesus. You aren't standing far off saying, "Do better." Your arms are open. You are ready and quick to forgive. So may we run to you this morning.
